notes.title: Minor Patch: Bug Fixes, Balancing & Optimization
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Necromancers![/p][p][/p][p]This minor update includes several important fixes and improvements to enhance your experience in [i]The Last Sanctum[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3]⚙️ [u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed two previously unusable characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected incorrect visual and sound effects for certain skills.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ [u]Balancing[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Adjustments have been made to the stats and performance of several skills and items to improve overall game balance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 [u]General Improvements[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Minor bugs have been addressed.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization work has been carried out to improve performance and stability.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and support. Stay tuned for more updates — and as always, may your summons never miss their mark![/p][p][/p][p]— [i]The Last Sanctum[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: More Languages Are Coming to The Last Sanctum!
notes.notes: [p][b]Greetings, Necromancers![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that **more language support is on the way** for *The Last Sanctum*!  [/p][p]Our goal is to make the game accessible to more players around the world, and we’re actively working on expanding our localization efforts.[/p][p][/p][p]🗺️ More languages will be added gradually in upcoming patches.  [/p][p]📜 Subtitles, UI, and menus will all be translated.  [/p][p]⚙️ We’ll also be optimizing support for different regional settings.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support — and may your summons never miss their mark.[/p][p][/p][p]— The Last Sanctum Dev Team[/p]
